transcript: A driver's license is a symbol of an adult status in many countries. The freedom to drive one's own car and go anywhere. It is an aspiration for many young people. segments.text: A driver's license is a symbol of an adult status in many countries.
The freedom to drive one's own car and go anywhere.
It is an aspiration for many young people.
The driving comes with great responsibility
A car is a convenient tool
But with a single wrong judgement
It can become a weapon that takes a life
The result of a wrong manoeuvre can be fatal
In recent years self-driving technology has advanced rapidly
The age is coming when AI handles many driving tasks
And the human operator is placed in a passive position
There are five levels of autonomous driving
Currently, most cars are around level two
They are at the stage of assisting some functions
Such as lane keeping and automatic braking
Fully autonomous driving level five is still under development
Whether AI can make smarter decisions
Then the human in complex traffic and traffic jams is still open to debate
In the case of an accident, who is responsible?
The driver, the car maker or the AI developer?
Current law has not caught up with this new phase
If autonomous driving spreads, the number of traffic deaths is expected to decrease
Accidents caused by human inattention, fatigue or drunk driving could be reduced
Although AI introduces risks of its own
But at the same time, many taxi and truck drivers may lose their jobs
But we must keep thinking about how society adapts
